Test Description: Initialize the USB xHCI host controller, set up event/command infrastructure, enable interrupts, reset and enable the root port, issue slot and address commands, and perform control transfers on EP0 to enumerate a device. Completion is indicated by event processing and normal test termination.
Meta Test Description: The test configures global USB controller registers, programs PIPE/PHY control, discovers capabilities, and initializes xHCI data structures (event ring segment table, scratchpad buffers, DCBAA). It sets Command Ring Control and configuration, programs DCBAAP, ERST size/base, ERDP, IMOD, IMAN, and enables interrupts via USBCMD and system INTR_EN0. It starts the controller (USBCMD=run), waits for an interrupt (int_pend cleared in ISR), services USBSTS/IMAN/ERDP, reads PORTSC, advances ERDP, resets the port, and proceeds through further port states. It builds and rings the doorbell for a slot enable and address device command via the Default Command Ring, sets up the Input Context for EP0, and re-issues an address command. The enumeration() function then constructs a series of EP0 transfer request blocks for GET DESCRIPTOR (Device), GET CONFIGURATION, SET CONFIGURATION, and subsequent GET CONFIGURATION stages, rings the doorbell, and polls the Event Ring for completion. The handler Default_IRQHandler reads mask/raw status, acknowledges the USB interrupt via IMAN and clears RAW_STCR0 before clearing the GIC IRQ. The test concludes by calling finish(0).
Remarks: Requires the host controller to be in Run state (USBCMD) with interrupts enabled (IMAN and INTR_EN0). Event Ring and DCBAA must be configured before issuing commands. Doorbell and Command Ring must be programmed prior to slot and address commands. Ensure PORTSC is transitioned through reset to an operational state.
